01 / THE RECOVERY LOOP

A recommendation is a start.
Verification is the finish.

A successful payment can leave an unpaid order behind. PayTrace Recover is designed to connect the evidence, explain the failure, and carry an approved correction through to a checked outcome.

01

Detect

Find where payment and store records disagree.

02

Investigate

Four specialists trace the evidence and challenge the findings.

03

Approve

The merchant reviews the exact change before it runs.

04

Correct

Apply the approved update to the existing store record.

05

Verify

Read both systems again. Close the case only when they agree.

↔
“The write succeeded” isn’t the same as “the problem is fixed.”

If verification fails, the case stays open. A retry checks the records without repeating the correction.

Test the failure path ↗
